tool_arguments.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Production sprite source for educational YouTube videos. Create a strict3 by3 row-major grid of NINE full-body poses, every cell equal size. Highest native resolution available, transparent RGBA background. Input image1 is the EXACT adopted identity/style reference, not a pixel-edit target. Redraw fresh. The exact adopted Vaquita shown in image1; identity features: 灰い丸い胴・暗い眼口周り・小さい三角背鰭. Remain a simplified bird-like/water-animal PROP, never a humanoid. Preserve precisely the existing anatomical body, wings/fins/flippers/feet/tail that are visible; no human arms, hands, legs, teeth, clothing or anime eyes. Use broad clean colour blocks, no detailed feather barbs or naturalistic diagram. Preserve its exact eye format when open (white surrounds only if the reference has them, same pupil and no added highlights), facial markings, palette, warm brown contours and subtle paper/watercolor texture. No realistic animal proportions or heavy outline change. All poses keep SAME anatomical head/body scale and proportions as the adopted reference, including every resting/blink/crouch state. Lots of true transparent padding around each complete subject and between cells; no cropped horns/gills/bill/tail/feet. No text, labels, grid lines, backgrounds, ground/shadow, props, sparkles, extra animals or duplicate/disconnected limbs. Required reading order left-to-right then top-to-bottom: 1 BLINK: Same exact upright/resting body position, head size, torso length/width, limbs, supports and facing as image1, ONLY the eye(s) gently fully closed as a simple brown lid curve; mouth/expression otherwise unchanged. Do not crouch, nod, shrink or move the body during blink. 2 GREET: Gentle greeting using a small lift of a reference-existing wing/flipper or a small head acknowledgment, anatomy unchanged and no new limbs. 3 PRESENT_LEFT: Direct the bill/head/gaze and an existing wing/flipper if suitable toward VIEWER LEFT; keep real existing anatomy. 4 PRESENT_RIGHT: Naturally turn the head/body to indicate VIEWER RIGHT using only the existing bill/head/wing/flipper. Not a simple flip-copy; preserve asymmetrical markings/anatomy. 5 THINK: A small thoughtful/curious head tilt or downward glance, same dot-eye and body, no human hand. 6 AHA: Small alert discovery: head slightly perks up and existing wing/flipper moves a little if suitable, solid reference eye; no effect. 7 CHEER: Pleased gentle celebration with existing wings/flippers opened a little or body perking naturally. Keep real anatomy and simple eye, no human mouth. 8 SPECIES_A: A small paddle stroke of the reference-visible pectoral flipper(s), angled a little forward/up, with body centre steady. 9 SPECIES_B: The same flipper(s) return a little back/down while the single tail and reference head projection remain intact. Species constraint: 脚や人の腕を追加しない。クジラ・ネズミイルカ・ジュゴンの尾や背鰭の有無を混同せず、浮遊中心の支点を足支点へ変えない。 Clean bounded color areas and connected silhouettes; no pigment spills, background haze or extra marks. Do not insert an additional neutral; it is reused from image1.
CRITICAL TRANSPARENCY: true RGBA isolated sprites only. Every pixel outside the separated character silhouettes must have alpha 0, including all gutters and all four canvas corners. Do not paint a beige/white/grey paper rectangle, backdrop, floor, contact shadow, border, diffuse halo, ambient shadow, red/yellow low-alpha colour field or speckles. Watercolour texture must be clipped to the characters themselves. Fresh original drawing, no postprocessing.
